_metadata.description: First-party HTTP response semantics for API handlers and route registration.

requirements.title: Status code checks avoid brittle error guessing
requirements.description: The validator reports raw numeric status literals and clearly implicit success on direct error responses while avoiding speculative call-graph guesses that would create false positives.

validation.notes: Implemented ref: api/internal/validation/http_semantics_test.go. Fixtures cover raw status literals and implicit stdlib JSON error success without speculative call-graph guesses.

requirements.title: Content type checks are response-pattern aware
requirements.description: The validator detects missing content types for obvious JSON encoders, text/html, text/plain, text/csv, application/pdf, binary downloads, XML, and server-sent event streams without requiring every handler to duplicate framework-provided headers.

validation.notes: Implemented ref: api/internal/validation/http_semantics_test.go. Fixtures cover obvious stdlib JSON response writes, explicit Content-Type headers, framework-owned responses, and test-file exclusions.

requirements.title: Feature endpoints are versioned and ops probes exempted
requirements.description: Route registration and endpoint metadata distinguish public feature APIs, Connect procedure paths, static assets, and operational probes so versioning findings only apply to first-party REST feature endpoints.

validation.notes: Implemented ref: api/internal/validation/http_semantics_test.go. Fixtures cover /api/v1 subrouters, /health, endpoint metadata rest_exception, and unversioned REST feature paths.
